summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its net asset value (NAV) per share as of May 31, 2026. The filing provides a breakdown of NAV components, including commercial mortgage loans ($291.5M), real estate owned ($99.8M), real estate securities ($10.0M), cash ($81.4M), and various liabilities, resulting in aggregate NAV attributable to common stock of $134.8M on 10.1M shares outstanding, or $13.3191 per share. The NAV is determined by the Advisor and posted monthly on the company’s website. The public offering terminated November 1, 2025. This is a routine periodic disclosure with no event-driven special situation.
